subject.title: openai-completions: chat-completions refusal field dropped, assistant turn resolves to empty content

question: Which open fix PR should maintainers treat as the canonical landing path for this chat-completions refusal-drop bug?
rationale: The issue itself is valid and source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs target the same root cause and only one should land.

options.title: Use the complete candidate
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102344 as canonical because it covers both assemblers, delta and message forms, tests, and contributor runtime proof.

options.title: Choose a different PR
options.body: A maintainer may pick another open candidate if its final diff, CI, or proof is stronger, then close the duplicate candidates after merge.

options.title: Ask for consolidation
options.body: Ask contributors to consolidate the best pieces into one branch if maintainers do not want to select among duplicate implementations directly.

recommendation.title: Use the complete candidate
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102344 as canonical because it covers both assemblers, delta and message forms, tests, and contributor runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical choice crosses the shared `packages/ai` runtime and duplicate landing decision, where recent history points to shared AI runtime ownership.
